title: Deferment of Income Tax Payment for Retrenched Citizens
what_it_is: Deferment of Income Tax Payment for Retrenched Citizens

sections.label: Tax hardship instalment plans
sections.summary: A taxpayer facing financial hardship may apply to IRAS for longer instalment plans, though IRAS generally does not waive income tax liabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: A taxpayer who faces financial hardship may apply to IRAS for longer instalment plans.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: As a general rule, IRAS does not waive income tax liabilities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: You need to have some financial prudence and discipline but, at the same time, you also need to balance that where individuals generally want to pay but for some reason, their circumstances really, really do not allow them to.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, the best approach is to speak to IRAS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: They would try, where possible, to exercise flexibility.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: But at the end of the day, we have to do two things: maintain the fiscal prudence and discipline in tax recovery for the state and, where possible, balance that with compassion on the part of individuals.
